data.title: bn-3h6y: Retain honest verification observations and record context
data.description: Retain the pre-dispatch and ending passive gate observations, derive record context from accepted selectors and durable acquisition, and preserve typed recovery on failure. Strict offline workspace Clippy and focused offline regressions passed. The pre-commit check passed and ran its pre-existing disposable loopback regression. No external or pinned owned fixture or live oracle qualification was started.

data.body: [HIGH] The admission can label evidence from one claim with another accepted lead. prepare_inner resolves the supplied Claim and freezes its bindings at preflight.rs:522–536, then declare_request resolves lead_id and lead_revision independently from normalized input at store/mod.rs:3135–3155. The live guard only requires those selectors to exist. VerificationContext copies them at record.rs:97–103, and publication checks that same acceptance, so a mismatched claim or a lead revision that changes during planning can publish evidence for bindings the accepted lead revision never supplied. Bind the experiment to the exact stored lead revision selected by acceptance, or fence the verified snapshot and reject a mismatch before adapter calls. Cover distinct leads and a same-lead revision race offline.

[HIGH] The recorded target identity claims authority that acquisition did not establish. execute_live accepts a separately parsed TargetOrigin after preparation at rounds.rs:691–697 and builds requests directly from it at rounds.rs:1093–1094. TargetOrigin verifies syntax, while this code labels that origin OperatorAsserted and substitutes the manifest version.* selector for a deployment marker. The operator-owned runtime already binds an origin and target selector at workspace.rs:90–98 and validates the target against the manifest at workspace.rs:187–195. Bind that admitted identity to the prepared acquisition before any dispatch. Keep deployment_marker absent unless the runtime carries an explicit marker assertion or the endpoint supplies an observed marker. The record should reject a late mismatch and keep unavailable identity facts unknown.

[MEDIUM] Durable unknown effects do not control the typed failure exposed to callers. An unresolved send persists Effect::Unknown at rounds.rs:1794–1797 but returns the underlying error at rounds.rs:1817–1824. The execution? at rounds.rs:816 bypasses EffectsUnknown at rounds.rs:847, so the wrapper can expose EvidenceIncomplete/Invalid or DependencyUnavailable even though its durable effects say Unknown. docs/adr/cross-lane-contracts.md:30 requires EFFECT_UNKNOWN for an unresolved send. Add a failure code/disposition derived from the durable effect while preserving the original source and both selectors. Separately, classify EvidenceError backend/I/O and integrity failures as dependency/integrity errors, not EvidenceIncomplete/Invalid (rounds.rs:370–373), consistent with preflight.rs:452–468 and record.rs:244–268. Exercise the real wrapper with offline fault injection after step intent.

data.body: [MEDIUM] The live path now discards an otherwise complete oracle acquisition when only cleanup dispatch is uncertain. finish_failed_step persists the unknown C effect and returns Ok for cleanup at rounds.rs:1794–1824, preserving the required observation flows. This new blanket return makes evaluate_and_store unreachable for that case, while record/tests.rs:871–919 explicitly expects a preserved True with Cleanup::Unknown after a lost cleanup response. That regression test bypasses execute_live and check_execution. Preserve the ability to evaluate and retain the witnessed result with honest Effect::Unknown/Cleanup::Unknown when uncertainty is confined to cleanup. Keep conflict ownership and any separately required settlement/publication refusal for unresolved effects. Add coverage that goes through the sealed acquisition path.

Fixed. Preflight checks the accepted lead ID and planned revision plus the immutable stored class, property, and slot values before adapters. Offline regressions cover a different lead, changed slots, and a same-lead amendment with identical material between planning and acceptance.

Fixed. Live preflight binds the selected manifest and its operator runtime target. Execution refuses a late origin or target-selector mismatch before capture or dispatch and uses the sealed origin. Deployment marker, address list and TLS identity remain absent unless independently established.

Fixed. The shared execution error boundary derives EFFECT_UNKNOWN and Error from durable uncertainty while keeping the causal error, run ID, request key and capture handle. Acquisition and record evidence use the same dependency, integrity and incompleteness mapping. An offline lost plant receipt exercises the production error wrapper after step intent.

Fixed. The sealed acquisition boundary keeps complete predicate evidence when unknown effects belong only to cleanup and preserves the durable per-object outcomes and Unknown or Partial cleanup summary. Unlinked evaluation remains available, while publication returns EFFECT_UNKNOWN and durable conflicts remain owned. The offline regression passes both lost-cleanup positions through the production seal boundary and checks retained predicate evidence.

[HIGH] Live admission can mix the selected operator runtime with a different verifier project and engine. LiveServices accepts independent Teapot, Evidence and runtime references at lines 259–263. The new binding check validates manifest, target, pass digest and slots, but never compares the adapter executable, project, environment or bound engine to runtime.teapot/runtime.engine, or request.pass_file to runtime.pass.path. The gate validates the supplied Teapot against its own engine (teapot/verifier_gate.rs:321–323, 349–359), and execute_live only checks that the same supplied instance returns (rounds.rs:750–762). If the coordinator accidentally pairs the selected runtime with another Teapot project using the same physical pass and session names, the checks accept and dispatch using the wrong project and credentials under the selected runtime’s target assertion. This violates docs/adr/cross-lane-contracts.md:109. Construct the adapters from the same validated runtime or compare their inert bindings, including the accepted pass path, before the first adapter call. Seal the selected evidence adapter through execution as well. Add an offline mismatched-project/engine regression that fails before adapter activity.

data.body: Fixed. LiveServices can only be created after an inert comparison with the operator runtime. The comparison covers the Teapot executable and wrapper kind, project, directory environment, and full BoundEngine, plus the exact qualified Investigation executable, case, workspace, import, and scratch roots. The pass pathname is checked before the first preflight command. Execution refuses a different Teapot or Evidence instance before opening capture. Offline regressions exercise mismatched project and engine, executable and environment, each Investigation route component, and the pass path.

LiveServices::new inertly compares Teapot executable/wrapper, project, environment and BoundEngine plus the exact qualified Evidence authority (preflight.rs:344-355; teapot/mod.rs:131-138; evidence/mod.rs:424-426). prepare_declared checks the runtime manifest/artifact, target selector, override bindings and exact pass path before check_new_run or any adapter/evidence call (preflight.rs:413-438, 909-920). LiveAdmission retains the exact Teapot and Evidence instances; execute_live rejects either substitution plus late target/selector drift before capture or durable effects, then validates the admitted pass/accounting binding (preflight.rs:395-397, 600-651; rounds.rs:796-816). The matching end observation is retained in the same capture and now also rejects pass ID/digest/path substitution (rounds.rs:872-894, 979-990). Offline regressions cover cross-wired Teapot/Evidence, pass-path mismatch, project/engine substitution, accounting substitution, target drift, and end-pass substitution; strict locked/offline all-target/all-feature Clippy and serialized offline just check pass, as do the exact qualified Investigation publication tests 4/4. No target traffic was sent.

data.body:
[HIGH] The final reconciliation regresses th-ux21bn. lock_declared passes request.pins() into claim_verification_conflicts, but those pins contain only lead ID/revision plus manifest data; check_verification_pins at store/mod.rs:2707-2736 never compares the persisted lead revision's class, property, or slots with request.claim. Because PreflightDeclaration/Claim are public, a caller can pair an accepted lead ID/revision with different claim material, freeze that material into the experiment, and obtain evidence attributed to a lead revision that never supplied it. Earlier commit b1ca4e7 had this binding and focused tests; both are absent from the reconciled target. Fix this inside the current transactionally exact admission path (not by restoring the duplicate accepted_claim_matches/publication path), before adapters or effects, and restore focused regression coverage.

Failure modes: mismatched class/property/slots, duplicate or reordered slots, a same-lead amendment race, and replay of an accepted request with substituted claim material. Edge-case validation: exact stored-vs-frozen comparison must reject duplicate names, missing/extra slots, unsupported/non-string stored slot values, and both distinct-lead and same-lead revision mismatches. Rollback: revert/disable the affected live verification admission until binding is restored; evidence produced by this target needs revalidation before trust. Monitoring: record a redacted admission-refusal metric/audit event for material mismatch keyed by accepted lead revision and experiment digest, without slot values. Input validation: transactionally bind accepted ID+revision to the persisted class/property/slots and the exact frozen claim before opening adapters, captures, or effects.

data.reason: HIGH: final reconciliation no longer binds the accepted lead revision material (class/property/slots) to the frozen claim before adapters/effects; th-ux21bn is reopened with a current anchored finding.

data.body: Fixed at 88c06aae5a349b2afdaf514fe4d2bee0774aa850 (full-range sha256 6caba1cfc18ed99cb7696433c965a7e8b4ceb7d781a465988a71f20b7d101d90). Private VerificationPins now carries the resolved Claim and FrozenExperiment (store/mod.rs:203-211; preflight.rs:184-219). The existing admission/conflict transactions compare current accepted lead ID/revision, exact class/property, canonical complete stored slots, normalized claim slots, frozen lead bindings and digests, manifest property resource/digest, and the accepted experiment digest before receipt/conflicts or adapters (store/mod.rs:2729-2868; preflight.rs:760-774, 837-867). Focused regressions at preflight/tests.rs:818-1067 cover exact match, missing/extra/changed/non-string/duplicate/reordered slots, class/property/resource drift, malformed/noncanonical rows, distinct lead, same-revision substituted material, amendment/revision movement and replay, with zero receipt/conflict/adapter/Evidence/Teapot/publication effects. A refusal audit was intentionally not added because failed admission is required to leave no revision/audit receipt; the typed refusal remains observable without persisting slot values. Strict offline all-target/all-feature Clippy, serialized offline just check, exact SIGKILL, and qualified Investigation 4/4 pass.

The exact stored lead revision material is now transactionally bound to the private claim/frozen experiment pins, both on first acceptance and conflict-claim replay, without restoring accepted_claim_matches or exposing a writer/proof constructor (store/mod.rs:203-211, 2729-2868; preflight.rs:184-219, 760-774, 837-867). Distinct-lead, same-ID/revision substituted material, same-lead amendment/revision movement, and exact replay are covered offline at preflight/tests.rs:818-1067; every refusal precedes adapters and durable execution/publication effects. Full serialized offline just check and the focused/qualified suites pass.
